digest.component_or_area: plan review verdict dispatch and criteria assembly
propositions: CriteriaError raised during deterministic criteria assembly is incorrectly routed through generic LLM-degradation tail and stamped with llm_unavailable=true even though no LLM call executed
The workflow interpreter records typed exceptions only as undifferentiated strings, causing loss of structured failure identity needed to discriminate config faults from genuine LLM outages

Plan review verdict must distinguish config-fault INDETERMINATE (with actionable installed-build/repository-checkout diagnostic) from llm_unavailable INDETERMINATE, while preserving deterministic findings and fail-closed behavior
Criteria assembly must emit a failed StepResult with stable failure_kind marker and original diagnostic, routed before generic degradation to a dedicated config-fault verdict path
Deterministic blockers must remain BLOCK and not be masked by config-fault classification
